notes.title: Patch Jan, 12, 2024
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with secondary item durability.
Improved controller aim.

notes.title: Small update. Dec 12, 2023
notes.content: Fixed vending machine and locker placement sometimes blocking level passages.

notes.title: Update Dec 9, 2023
notes.content:
Fixed enemies sometimes spawning behind locked doors.
Fixed level exits sometimes being placed out of reach of the player.

Still working on better aim when using a controller.

notes.title: Update. Fixed control remapping.
notes.content: Fixed a bug relating to remapping controller and keyboard keys.

notes.title: Update 2. Nov 16, 2023
notes.content:
Enemies now drop more credits.
Fixed enemies spawning in to close to the player when entering a new area.
Fixed player buffs not resetting in some instances.

notes.title: Update Nov 20, 2023
notes.content:
Reduced enemy crowding when entering a new level.
Fixed rare bug with shields that can cause a crash.

notes.title: Update Nov 17
notes.content:
Fixed currency not resetting after game restart.
Fixed keys not resetting.
Fixed pathfinding bug that may cause a rare crash.

notes.title: Edge Of Dead Update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/32b5c669c4491c35b1e81222b4e911a0bc993b66.png[/img]
[h2]Progress[/h2]
Edge Of Dead is progressing nicely. With all of the core mechanics finished work now is focused on finishing the remaining content, squashing bugs, and balancing game play. No final release date has been determined but it’s close. The prologue may get some attention before then too. Look here for weekly updates.

[h2]More Pixels[/h2]
Artwork in the orbiting freighter level has been reworked. Added these cryogenic chambers. I wonder what or who is in them?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/adf034113433fce93f19491ef9e54dee81d6ff58.gif[/img]

[h2]Hazards[/h2]
Hazards in the industrial area include an out of control lightning tower. After much thought it was decided that the player should be able to destroy environmental hazards like this but not easily.

Smashing stuff was added recently. Each area now has it's own type of unique destructable clutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/2f5ec8d3a35a2f6282e2be5a014a05dcfcb60022.gif[/img]

[h2]Check out the prologue[/h2]
Have you always wanted to fight bone spiders, robots and a walking cactus at the same time? Now you can in the Edge Of Dead Prologue. It's available now. Get it here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484450?utm_source=EdgeOfDeadNew

notes.title: Edge Of Dead Prologue Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/79b0aaccd394e4a2d4fd707c6ba84346d0fb90d6.png[/img]

The 'Edge Of Dead Prologue' includes the first full level of the full game with a newly generated map every run, lots of enemy encounters, a shop and lots of loot to find. The game is set in a distant star system and pits the player against an alien invasion.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484450]Edge Of Dead Prologue[/url]

You will start by choosing a crew member, then move from one randomly generated level to another fighting numerous enemies in each level. You’ll need to clear the level of enemies before proceeding to the next. The game involves finding weapons, loot and money from various caches scattered around the level and from vanquished enemies. You can use these found items to power up your character before moving on to the next battle. There is an inventory system which allows you to see an items attributes and decide how and when to best use it. If your character dies during a run the game starts from the beginning and you will have to choose a new character and begin a new run. Choose a crew member, grab a weapon, and prepare for chaos in the Edge Of Dead prologue!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
This update includes gamepad support and the ability to remap controls. There is also a new inventory management system and map screen to make teleporting around and examining your loot easier. The update also includes numerous bug fixes.

Hope you enjoy the demo and feel free to leave feedback.
